en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town or village nestled in a hilly, tree‑covered landscape. Several farmhouses and buildings with gabled roofs are visible, along with winding roads and open fields. The printed caption below the image identifies the location as Beek near Nijmegen and states that the view is from the Sterrenberg. There is cursive handwriting in ink along the bottom margin. On the right border there is a vertical printer's credit indicating phototype production in Nijmegen.
